title: Fospha - Click Z Graduate Content and Audience Strategist
description: <p>Do you follow every shift in digital marketing, media and commerce, and always have a view on which stories matter the most?</p> <p>Do you want to create content across channels that educates the next generation of marketers?</p> <p>Does the idea of shaping the content for one of digital marketing's longest-running publications excite you?</p> <p><strong>If so, we'd love to hear from you!</strong></p> <hr> <h2>About us</h2> <p>Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.</p> <p><strong>About ClickZ</strong></p> <p><a href="https://clickz.com/">ClickZ</a> is Fospha's media partner and one of the world's longest-running digital marketing publications, trusted by CMOs and senior marketers since 1997. Its focus is how measurement shapes marketing decisions, and it covers the wider marketing that measurement informs. Readers come to ClickZ to understand:</p> <ul> <li>How marketing leaders build teams, explain results to finance and earn influence in the room</li> <li>Retail and commerce marketing, including retail media and marketplaces</li> <li>How AI, search and ad platform changes affect planning and results</li> <li>Where to invest across brand, creative, performance, affiliate and influencer marketing</li> <li>How brands measure performance, from attribution and incrementality to mix modelling</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>This is a permanent role at the heart of ClickZ. You'll run the day-to-day content engine: spotting the stories that matter to marketing leaders, turning them into sharp content across email, social and the website, and growing the audience that reads it.</p> <p>The work is varied. In a single week you might cover a session at a major commerce event, publish a piece on a platform change, prepare a leadership Q&A, and review a stack of contributor pitches. You'll also build ClickZ's network of event partners, contributors, PR contacts and industry leaders, and meet many of them in person at industry events.</p> <p>You'll work closely with ClickZ's lead, who sets the brand's strategy, and you'll have real ownership of your workstreams from the start. This is an <strong>office-based role</strong> in London.</p> <p>This role suits someone with a journalist's instinct for a story, a marketer's eye for an audience, and the energy to keep both going every week.</p> <h2> </h2> <h2>What you'll work on</h2> <p>Your time will be spread across three areas, with content creation at the core. All three serve one goal: growing the ClickZ brand and getting its content to more of the right people.</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Focus area</th> <th>What it covers</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td>Content creation</td> <td>The core of the role: editorial content on market trends, event coverage, brand leadership interviews and Q&As, flagship newsletters, and social content</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Audience growth and content analysis</td> <td>Growing ClickZ's readership and subscribers, testing new formats, and using performance data to decide what to create next</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Network and community</td> <td>Building relationships with event partners, marketing and commerce leaders, PR teams and contributors, online and in person at industry events</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <h2> </h2> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Keep the content engine fed.</strong> Track the news and trends that matter to marketing and commerce leaders, and turn them into timely, well-argued content.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar on every channel.</strong> Bring a creative eye to email, social and web content, and build a distinct content plan for each channel.</li> <li><strong>Shape the flagship newsletters.</strong> Draft and refine ClickZ's flagship newsletters, and develop more tailored formats for different parts of the audience.</li> <li><strong>Bring leadership conversations to life.</strong> Prepare and support podcast and Q&A conversations with leaders across marketing and commerce, and, with training and support, grow into hosting them.</li> <li><strong>Grow the audience.</strong> Work out which formats and topics readers respond to, and turn readers into subscribers. Design campaigns that bring back readers who've gone quiet.</li> <li><strong>Let data inform the calls.</strong> Track what content delivers, use the numbers to decide what to do next, and share what's working.</li> <li><strong>Be the first filter.</strong> Review PR pitches and contributor submissions, and pick out the strong and relevant ones.</li> <li><strong>Build the network.</strong> Reach out to contributors, speakers and event partners, grow an always-on contributor community, and build lasting relationships with PR teams and industry leaders.</li> <li><strong>Get out into the industry.</strong> Attend events, support event partnerships, and find new events worth ClickZ's time.</li> <li><strong>Work agentically.</strong> Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting and multimedia content, while owning the quality of what goes out.</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2>What are we looking for?</h2> <p>We hire for potential and taste. You should apply if you meet these six must-haves:</p> <ul> <li>Have around one year of experience creating content in the digital marketing, media or commerce world, whether in journalism, editorial, content or social roles (internships, placements and personal projects count), and a genuine passion for digital marketing and commerce, and for the leaders shaping them</li> <li>Have <strong>strong editorial judgement</strong>: you can tell good content from weak, and relevant from noise, and you know a big story when you see one (experience of writing, editing or curating, including student or personal publications)</li> <li>Bring a <strong>creative eye to content</strong> across email, social and web, with a feel for multimedia formats</li> <li>Are <strong>audience-minded</strong>: you think about who's reading, how to reach more of the right people and how to build a community around a brand. You're also comfortable with data: you use performance numbers to make content decisions and back up your conclusions (experience using analytics such as GA4)</li> <li>Are <strong>agentically minded</strong>: you love experimenting with new tools for multimedia content creation and adaptation, and know when to push them and when to take over</li> <li>Are <strong>a natural conversationalist</strong>: you get a guest talking, hold your own with senior leaders, and leave an event with new connections</li> </ul> <p><strong>Also important:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have <strong>high agency</strong>: you take ownership of your work, stretch beyond the brief and challenge the status quo when something could be better</li> <li>Enjoy a fast-paced, innovative startup environment, where you'll ship quickly, iterate often and juggle several projects at once</li> <li>Are happy to travel for industry events, within the UK and occasionally overseas</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2>Our Values and Principles</h2> <p>You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Seek inclusion & diversity:</strong> We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard</li> <li><strong>Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together:</strong> We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact</li> <li><strong>Grow:</strong> We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure</li> <li><strong>Customer at the heart:</strong> We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems</li> <li><strong>Candour with caring:</strong> We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2>What we can offer you</h2> <ul> <li>Salary: £34k + discretionary 10% bonus</li> <li>Ownership of content for a media brand that has covered digital marketing for nearly 30 years</li> <li>Early ownership of your workstreams, and the chance to shape how modern marketers learn and make decisions</li> <li>A growing network across PR teams, contributors and industry leaders</li> <li>Hands-on podcast experience, with regular conversations with leaders across marketing and commerce</li> <li>A place at major industry events, with a front-row view of commerce, media and digital marketing</li> <li>Be part of a leading global venture builder, <a href="https://blenheimchalcot.com/blog">Blenheim Chalcot</a>, and learn from the incredible talent in BC</li> <li>The right mix of challenges, learning and development opportunities</li> <li>A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%</li> <li>A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!</li> <li>Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps</li> <li>25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)</li> <li>Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one</li> <li>Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more</li> <li>Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance</li> <li>Paid volunteering days each year</li> <li>Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community</li&g

title: Senior Business Development Manager - AI Native
description: <h2><strong>ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD:</strong></h2> <p>NexGen Cloud is the company behind Hyperstack, a full-stack AI cloud serving tens of thousands of customers from AI researchers to enterprises running the world's most compute-intensive workloads. We deliver on-demand and private GPU infrastructure to teams who treat performance as a requirement, not a feature.</p> <p>We're a tight-knit, fast-moving team working at the cutting edge of AI cloud infrastructure. We practice what we preach, equipping our people with AI at every level so we can solve harder problems, ship faster, and keep raising the bar for what enterprise GPU infrastructure looks like.</p> <h2><strong>THE ROLE: Senior Business Development Manager – Vertical Markets</strong></h2> <p>Hyperstack already runs production GPU capacity at scale for AI start-ups, AI service providers and enterprise AI teams. This role exists to extend that position into compute-intensive, regulated and specialist industries — financial services, healthcare and life sciences, robotics and autonomous systems, computer vision and industrial AI — where compute budgets are already committed and infrastructure partners are being chosen now.</p> <p>You'll own a named vertical end to end: the demand thesis, the target account map, the outbound motion, and every deal through to signature. This is a full-cycle role with real ownership, not a top-of-funnel handoff — you'll become the recognised commercial authority for your vertical inside NexGen, and a credible presence in that industry externally.</p> <p><em>Role positioning: this is a role for a senior seller who already holds trust in a compute-intensive industry and wants full ownership of turning that trust into a book of business — the strategy, the pipeline and the close.</em></p> <h2><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:</strong></h2> <p>Rather than a long checklist, here's what success in this role looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Own a named vertical end to end — build the demand thesis, size the addressable market, and turn it into a prioritised target account map</li> <li>Self-source the majority of your own pipeline and reach the people who decide compute budget: CIO, CTO, Chief Data or AI Officer, and the procurement and risk functions that gate them</li> <li>Lead technical discovery to a real specification, then own the full cycle to signature — commercial proposal, security review, procurement, legal and MSA negotiation</li> <li>Structure multi-year committed reservations and on-demand entry points, and keep a forecast the business can plan capacity against</li> <li>Build Hyperstack's presence in your vertical — industry events, analyst and partner relationships, reference customers and case studies</li> <li>Feed vertical requirements into Product, Capacity and Marketing with enough specificity to change decisions, then follow through until they land</li> <li>Act as the internal reference point for your vertical — brief the wider Sales team and raise the technical floor around you</li> </ul> <h2><strong>ABOUT YOU:</strong></h2> <p>We're more interested in how you think and work than in a perfect CV. You'll likely bring a combination of the following:</p> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years in business development, enterprise sales or solution sales, including at least 3 years carrying a new business number in complex enterprise environments</li> <li>A demonstrable record of opening net-new enterprise logos from a standing start — self-sourced, not inherited and not renewal-led</li> <li>Deep credibility in at least one compute-intensive vertical — financial services, healthcare and life sciences, robotics and autonomous systems, computer vision and industrial AI, media and entertainment, or engineering and simulation — including an active network at buying level</li> <li>Substantive infrastructure fluency (cloud, IaaS, HPC, data centre, GPU or AI compute), or a proven history of learning a technical domain to the point of holding your own with engineers</li> <li>Evidence of closing complex deals through procurement, security review and legal, with contract values and cycle lengths you can talk to in detail</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience at a neo-cloud, GPU-as-a-Service platform, hyperscaler or HPC infrastructure vendor</li> <li>Prior ownership of a vertical or industry go-to-market as a named remit</li> <li>Familiarity with regulated buying environments — data residency and sovereignty, isolation requirements, and the security and compliance reviews that come with them</li> <li>Experience selling committed capacity or reservation-style contracts rather than pure consumption</li> <li>Formal sales methodology — MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or equivalent</li> </ul> <h2><strong>WHAT WE OFFER:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and accelerators above target, plus equity participation</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance </li> <li>Employee wellbeing benefits</li> <li>25 days of holiday, plus public holidays</li> <li>Hybrid working, with Tuesday to Thursday in the London office</li> <li>Real ownership of a named vertical, with the trust to build and run it as your own</li> <li>A clear route to principal-level individual contribution or vertical leadership as your vertical scales</li> <li>A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership</li> <li>The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud's team, culture, and future alongside ambitious, mission-driven colleagues</li> </ul> <h2><strong>MORE INFORMATION</strong></h2> <p>Head over to our <a space.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Data Analyst
description: <p><strong>ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD</strong></p> <p>NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We're the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.</p> <p>We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.</p> <p><strong>THE ROLE: Data Analyst</strong></p> <p>NexGen Cloud is moving to a data-driven way of running the business. Right now, revenue, occupancy, billing and pipeline data live across data warehouses, business systems and APIs, and the numbers don't always agree. We're building out our Strategic Finance team so that leadership, sales and operations can rely on one set of figures and act on them daily.</p> <p>This role suits someone who enjoys the technical craft of data and wants to learn the commercial side of the AI compute market. We'll teach you that context. When a number looks wrong, you'll dig until you find why, and you'll come back with a fix as well as the problem.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING</strong></p> <p>Rather than a checklist, here's what success in this role actually looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain the pipelines that bring data from across the business into Databricks and Power BI, and automate the manual steps along the way</li> <li>Own the daily revenue and occupancy reporting that leadership uses to track how the GPU fleet is performing</li> <li>Check that what we bill matches what customers actually used, covering power draw, utilisation, asset registers and credits</li> <li>Support commission calculations and give sales leadership a clear view of pipeline health, conversion and churn</li> <li>Model pricing options and deal economics so investment decisions are grounded in real numbers</li> <li>Validate every figure before it reaches leadership or anyone outside the company</li> <li>Help the wider team work confidently with BI tools and data</li> </ul> <p><strong>ABOUT YOU</strong></p> <p>We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You'll likely bring a combination of the following:</p> <p><strong>Essential</strong><em>:</em></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, including data extraction, integration or automation projects</li> <li>Strong SQL and Excel skills</li> <li>Solid Power BI experience, including reconciling figures when different sources disagree</li> <li>Hands-on use of a CRM (HubSpot or similar), and of AI tools to speed up analysis and build work</li> <li>A root-cause mindset: you find the underlying cause rather than reporting the symptom, and you bring a proposed solution with it</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Databricks</li> <li>Exposure to billing, revenue assurance or commission processes, ideally in a cloud, SaaS or usage-based business</li> <li>Some experience with financial modelling or FP&A work</li> <li>Time spent in a high-growth company where data processes were still being built</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme</li> <li>Employee wellbeing benefits</li> <li>25 days holiday, plus public holidays</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance</li> <li>Enhanced Pension Scheme</li> <li>Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)</li> <li>Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment</li> <li>Visible, meaningful impact as we scale</li> <li>Clear career progression in a high-growth company</li> <li>A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership</li> <li>The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud's team, culture, and future</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY APPLY</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we'd like to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>MORE INFORMATION</strong></p> <p>Visit our <a href="https://www.nexgencloud.com/careers">careers page</a> to learn more about us or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexgen-cloud">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://x.com/CloudNexgen">X</a> to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.</p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit <span><a href="http://www.alpha-sense.com" target="_blank">www.alpha-sense.com</a></span>. Come join us.</span></p></div><h3>About the Team:</h3> <p>The Customer Success organisation is composed of three teams: Pre-sales, Customer Success, and Support. The Customer Success Manager will join a team of trusted partners alongside their Account Manager, working closely with newly onboarded and existing clients to demonstrate the full value of our platform, develop strong client engagement, drive successful renewals and contribute to growth across dedicated accounts. They are natural problem-solvers, storytellers and product experts who thrive on helping customers make better and faster decisions.</p> <p>Customer Success Managers combine deep product knowledge, industry experience and ability to build strong client relationships to ensure that each client interaction is both meaningful and impactful. Due to their extensive exposure to a variety of clients both on the buy-side and sell-side, they are the Voice of the Customer, working closely alongside our Product Management and Content teams to help determine future product developments, as well as playing a key role in product Betas and the customer feedback loop.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role: </strong></h3> <p>As a Forward-Deployed Banker, you will play a critical role in driving product adoption and delivering ongoing value to our clients, working closely with the wider account team to positively impact net retention. You’ll engage directly with clients and develop a comprehensive understanding of their workflows, challenges, and goals; bridging the gap between the powerful capabilities of our technology and the domain-specific needs of financial professionals across: Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Equity/Venture Capital and Hedge Funds.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do:<span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Partner with GTM Teams to Drive Commercial Outcomes:</strong> Collaborate closely with your Account Manager and the wider account management team to ensure continuous alignment of account strategies and goals. <br></span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Leverage Data Driven Insights</strong>: Use internal data tools to monitor client engagement, identify opportunities to showcase value, and strengthen platform adoption. Proactively seek growth opportunities while also detecting early signs of churn risk to support retention and long-term account success.<br></span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Build and Curate Financial Services Use Cases:</strong> Conduct targeted discovery into clients' unique research workflows and painpoints in order to help them effectively leverage AlphaSense for their bespoke use cases. Continue to seek out and develop new and emerging use cases with clients as AlphaSense’s capabilities evolve.<br></span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Forge and Maintain Strong Client Relationships:</strong> Engage directly with investment professionals of all levels/seniority at financial institutions to understand their most pressing challenges and goals. Deliver white glove service that puts the clients needs first; going above and beyond to build trust and credibility as a Trusted Partner and Product Expert.<br></span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Contribute to Product Development:</strong> Translate client feedback and proactively share product & content improvements/enhancement requests internally.</span></li> </ul> <h3>Who You Are:</h3> <p>You have a proven track record of working with Financial Services investors/clients to solve complex problems and are passionate about the application of AI to the industry. You are client-centric and creative thinker with an ambition to continuously improve processes and a desire to contribute to a fast-growing, entrepreneurial team culture. You are a natural problem solver and prioritise white glove service to go above and beyond for clients. You enjoy autonomy and proactively drive initiatives that contribute to long term success. You enjoy cross-functional partnerships and are able to build strong internal stakeholder relationships.</p> <h3>What You Bring:</h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Financial Services Expertise:</strong> 2+ years of front-office investment banking experience, ideally with exposure to more than one product area (e.g., DCM, ECM, M&A, Leveraged Finance), providing a strong foundation in capital markets processes and client-facing deal work.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Curiosity About Generative AI in Financial Services</strong>: A demonstrated interest in the transformative potential of AI for the financial sector, flexible problem-solving skills and knowledge of the competitive landscape for GenAI in Financial Services.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Executive Presence & Strong Presentation Skills</strong>: A proven capacity to engage stakeholders at all levels, earn their trust, and explain technical solutions to business-oriented audiences. Comfort with conducting evaluations of varying lengths/forms e.g. on-site workshops, whiteboard sessions, multi-call demos etc.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>High-Impact, Ownership Mindset:</strong> An exceptional ability to thrive on autonomy, tackle client questions and challenges with enthusiasm, and drive workflow transformation at some of the world's biggest financial firms.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Consultative Approach:</strong> A highly articulate, consultative, and confident client-facing professional with the ability to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Team Player: </strong>Superior ability to build and maintain strong internal relationships, combined with a positive and proactive personality.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Collaboration & Influence:</strong> Ability to work cross-functionally and effectively distill client feedback to GTM, Product, and Content teams, in order to continually help influence and improve our capabilities/product offerings.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>A Proactive Mindset</strong> with a passion for client success and continuous improvement</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements:</h3> <ul> <li>Minimum 2 years of front-office investment banking experience across at least one product area, with a solid grounding in capital markets and client-facing deal execution.</li> <li>High aptitude and willingness to learn.</li> <li>Outstanding oral, written, and presentation skills.</li> <li>Effective attention to detail, time management, and task prioritization, even when under pressure.</li> <li>Ability and interest to work autonomously and contribute to a dynamic and entrepreneurial team culture.</li> <li>Empathetic, curious minded, client-centric</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit <span><a href="http://www.alpha-sense.com" target="_blank">www.alpha-sense.com</a></span>. Come join us.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>Our Customer Success team is made up of Account Directors  and Customer Success Managers who are passionate about helping our clients succeed. We partner with a diverse range of organizations, from Fortune 1000 companies to some of the largest financial institutions globally.</p> <p>As a team, we are committed to providing value to our clients. We take a consultative approach to solve challenges through our product, ensuring our customers have the right data to make informed decisions. We focus on retaining customers, maximizing product usage, and collaborating with the sales team to uncover growth opportunities.</p> <p><strong>About the Role: </strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a high-impact Account Director to own and expand relationships with our most complex and high-value accounts within the Corporate Life Sciences sector. You'll be the primary point of contact for a book of Fortune 1000 accounts—driving renewals, adoption, and growth. In this role, you'll be expected to collaborate with account executives, identifying new business opportunities to help expand our footprint within each client account.</p> <p>While key performance indicators include retention rate and the identification of growth opportunities, the responsibilities of Account Directors go much deeper. The team also extracts a wealth of knowledge from our clients, bringing that internally to product, marketing and sales teams in order to maximize the effectiveness of our business' strategy and communication.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Forecast and maximize retention rate across your book of business</li> <li>Increase and drive adoption of AlphaSense solutions into other business units of existing clients to uncover new opportunities, exceeding monthly, quarterly and annual revenue goals</li> <li>Identify revenue at risk in order to best position the company to prevent churn</li> <li>Collaborate with Account Executives to identify growth opportunities within the book of business</li> <li>Understand the ins and outs of the business, roles, responsibilities, projects, performance metrics, etc. within our client base in order to more effectively: 1) communicate with users, 2) communicate with decision makers, 3) identify white space, 4) partner with AE to craft most compelling messaging to prospective users</li> <li>Cultivate relationships with users and key stakeholders to ensure AlphaSense is viewed as a business partner rather than vendor</li> <li>Hold Business Reviews with key stakeholders</li> <li>Consistent proactive outreach with material and information that’s relevant for our user base</li> <li>Serve as our boots on the ground and physical presence within each client (floor walks, lunch and learns, etc.)</li> <li>Serve as both the advocate for AlphaSense to the client, and the client advocate within AlphaSense</li> <li>Acquire value stories and product feedback from clients. Circulate internally to assist with product development, marketing, sales efforts</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Relationship-driven:</strong> You have a strong ability to develop instant rapport with new people and you’ve demonstrated success at managing and growing relationships within Fortune 1000 clients</li> <li><strong>A subject matter expert: </strong>You excel at what you do and know how to succeed within your role -- this includes both internal and external relationship management as well as strong business acumen and commitment to effective processes and tactics</li> <li><strong>Knowledgeable and experienced in Life Sciences: </strong>Experience working with clients in the Life Sciences industry, including Pharma, Biotech, Medical devices and diagnostics - additional bonus for familiarity with competitive intelligence, business development and clinical and commercial strategy workflows.</li> <li><strong>Energetic and creative: </strong>You possess a natural intellectual curiosity with the ability to learn and adapt quickly</li> <li>You understand our business: We are a rapidly growing SaaS company and are incredibly passionate about our product. We are looking for individuals who understand best practices for client engagement within a SaaS environment;</li> <li><strong>Committed to delivering results: </strong>You set the example for grit, work ethic, initiative, enthusiasm and commitment amongst your peers.</li> <li><strong>A strong communicator: </strong>You’ll regularly be engaged with day-to-day users to C-level executives and that requires exceptional oral, written and presentation skills. You’ll need to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Recruiting Scams and Fraud</span></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. title: Sales Engineer
description: At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution. We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints. With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge? About the role We are looking for a sales engineer to join our sales team and drive the frontline of industrial decarbonisation. This role bridges the technical and commercial worlds. You'll need interpersonal and technical skills to build relationships with process engineers in cement plants and understand their challenges. Analytical skills will be essential to delve deep into complex plant data and work out how Gigaton's AI products can solve their most critical issues. Building on that, you'll need strategic thinking and commercial awareness to turn your findings into concise, compelling proposals for decision-makers at our customers, from the C-suite down. Ultimately, you'll build clarity from uncertainty, making sure we agree a shared roadmap with our customers that puts our solutions on track for significant real-world benefits before a contract is signed. Over time, you’ll help us evolve our sales approach and shape the product by feeding insights and needs from the plant back to the product team, building the foundation for scaling across industries. Your main responsibilities Be the technical expert on sales calls and visits with cement plants. Build trust with process engineers and plant teams by understanding their specific plant issues and linking them to how we can help. Analyse plant data to identify and evaluate opportunities, then use this analysis to create compelling sales proposals. Lead technical discovery and identify early when a plant does not meet our ICP (ideal customer profile) criteria. Make sure relationships and plant understanding are handed over successfully to the deployment team. Act as a feedback loop into Gigaton’s product and machine learning teams, providing field insights that help shape our product roadmap. Develop and iterate the pre-sales technical process, making it more impactful and more automated each time. Travel to plants and conferences , around one week per month, to understand customer environments and explain the product. What a great fit looks like Exposure to physical sciences, controls, or heavy industry , such as cement, steel, energy, manufacturing, or similar. Strong analytical skills and an outcome-oriented mindset. You can dig into industrial data, identify root causes, generate potential solutions, and explain their value in dollars and tonnes of CO2. Excellent communication skills . You can build credibility and trust in complex industrial environments with both engineers and board-level stakeholders. Comfortable being the technical voice in the conversation , presenting to senior plant leaders and operators, handling objections, and being challenged on your findings by people who have run kilns for 30 years. Naturally curious and keen to learn about the industry, the technology, and each individual plant. You want to understand the root cause behind every question and objection so you can solve the right problem. Confident in ambiguity and able to field very specific technical questions without getting flustered. You know when you can give your understanding, when you need to go and find the answer, and how to maintain customer confidence in both situations. Willingness to travel regularly . You’ll excel if You build trust easily . You can connect with plant engineers, listen deeply, and align solutions to their priorities. You’d rather diagnose than pitch . Your first instinct in a plant is to ask a better question, not to open the deck. You thrive in dynamic environments . Fast-paced, ambiguous settings excite you, and you’re motivated by high-impact, mission-driven work. You have experience working in heavy industry , particularly cement, steel, energy, heavy manufacturing, or similar. Success in This Role Means Plants say yes because the technical case is clear. You build customer confidence that Gigaton can deliver high ROI, helping us hit our revenue goals without losing deals because customers don’t understand or believe in our product and capabilities. Deployments are set up to succeed . We haven’t overpromised to sign a contract, and our pre-contract analysis holds up once the system is live. Process engineers trust and rely on you as a partner in solving problems. Deals don’t stall waiting on a technical answer . Objections get handled quickly, and customers get the answers they need in good time. 💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match. We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from all walks of life, with different countries, cultures, and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you. The interview process Talent Partner Screen Call: Meet our talent partner and learn more about Gigaton and the role. Hiring Manager Screen: Meet our VP of Sales and discuss if this role is a good fit for you. Technical Onsite (completed on the same day): Technical interview Data analysis & presentation Operating Principles Interview: Understand how we work and whether Gigaton and you are a good fit for each other. Meet with the CEO: Every new potential hire meets Josh. We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll reference-check candidates before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us by chatting to team members you haven’t yet met. Ask anything. We’ll answer with Concrete Honesty. Once interviews are done, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to give feedback at any stage. In return for your hard work, we’ll give you 📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside. 🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team. 🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge 🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one. Our Operating Principles ↗️ Go Gig or Go Home : High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires. 🏭 Concrete Honesty : Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture. 🦾 Autonomous Ownership : High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it. 😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun : Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page. title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Applied AI
description: About LILT AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation. We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone , regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality. At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues— Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1 —guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation , Canva , the United States Department of Defense , the United States Air Force , ASICS , and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI. About the Role: As a Senior Technical Program Manager of Applied AI, you will sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and industrial-scale execution. You will operate with an entrepreneurial mindset, effectively acting as the CEO of your customer's business to proactively drive success. You are responsible for leading complex benchmark transformations and data deliverables. Rather than just managing timelines, you are architecting workflows to ensure the next generation of LLMs and multimodal models are trained on the most accurate, diverse, and complex data available, while championing innovative solutions alongside our research lab partners. Entrepreneurial Benchmark Leadership: Act as the CEO of your customer’s business by proactively proposing and co-developing benchmark transcreations directly with research lab partners, ensuring our deliverables are innovative, tailored, and aligned with their core research objectives. Frontier Lab Program Management: Lead the end-to-end execution of high-priority technical programs for frontier AI labs, managing the delivery of massive-scale datasets and bespoke engineering milestones. High-Volume Data Operations: Architect and oversee pipelines for delivering high-volume data samples across multiple modalities (text, image, video, audio), ensuring strict adherence to delivery cadences without sacrificing precision. End-to-End Quality Control: Partner with production to implement rigorous, automated, and human-in-the-loop QC frameworks to ensure data integrity across various domains and languages. Cross-Functional Leadership: Bridge the gap between forward-deployed engineering resources, research, and production teams to ensure LILT can serve the needs of the frontier AI market. Qualifications Education: B.S or M.S. in Computer Science, AI, or a related technical field with 10+ years of industry experience. Equivalently, a Ph.D. with 5+ years of experience in a high-growth AI/Engineering environment. Entrepreneurial Mindset: Experience founding or scaling a venture, or operating in an early-stage startup environment where you drove business growth and strategic initiatives from the ground up. Strategic Execution: Strong business acumen and the ability to manage high-stakes stakeholder relationships with frontier AI labs. Frontier AI Expertise: Proven track record of managing data pipelines for LLMs or multimodal models. Deep understanding of training, inference, and the nuances of data diversity (multilingual and multi-domain). Scale & Quality: Demonstrated ability to manage "high-throughput" programs where quality control is mission-critical. You should have experience with automated validation at scale. Preferred Skills Fluency in multiple human languages. Proficiency in Python and experience working with modern AI frameworks (PyTorch, LangChain, etc.). What We Offer: Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in a rapidly growing industry. A dynamic and collaborative work environment. Significant opportunities for professional growth and development. The chance to make a real impact on global communication and business. Where You’ll Work This position is based in our London, UK office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. Boston and Indianapolis are also acceptable locations. LILT is hybrid with hubs in SF, NY, Indianapolis, Boston, London, and Berlin. Authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment. London, UK (highly preferred) Others: Berlin, Boston, New York, Indianapolis Our Story Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born. LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI. With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning. Our Tech What sets our platform apart: Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review LILT in the News Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies! LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List . LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry. Check out all our news on our website . Information collected and processed as part of your application process, including any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to LILT's Privacy Policy at https://lilt.com/legal/privacy . title: Robotaxi Technical Operations Manager
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Technical Operations Teams Wayve’s Technical Operations function is the critical bridge between Product, Engineering, and Operations. We thrive in dynamic, high-growth environments, turning complex technical strategies into actionable field operations that set the standard for autonomy at scale. 🧠 Your day-to-day You’ll stand up and run technical operations in new markets—planning data collection campaigns, preparing vehicles and operators for launch, and running live robotaxi services with our ridehail partners. Your work will build the feedback loops that convert on-road data, operator insights, and service metrics into continuous product enhancements, demonstrating improvements through live operations. You’ll drive the pace and reliability required to deliver commercial services where customer experience and operational reliability are measured daily. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Market launch readiness: Turn program plans into clear, actionable launch plans by market, covering vehicle commissioning, operator readiness, route and ODD validation, and safety sign-offs. Lead go/no-go reviews across multiple regions. Third-party operator performance: Manage operating relationships with subcontracted partners, set and review SLAs and performance standards, run audit cycles, and drive corrective actions. Operator standards and train-the-trainer: Partner with Training to ensure trainers are certified, curricula keep pace with releases, and operator competence is consistently assessed in every market. Release and change management: Coordinate how software and model releases reach the road, from operator briefings and in-car checks to staged rollouts and structured field feedback. Performance reporting: Own weekly product performance reporting—including autonomy time, pickups/drop-offs, km driven, and safety events—and turn trends into priority actions for Operations, Engineering, and Product. Field-to-model feedback loops: Be the link between on-road operations and model, product, and research teams. Triage on-road events, route insights, and design targeted testing to close data gaps. Scaling the playbook: Improve processes, SOPs, and tooling so each new market launches faster and more safely. 🙌 You should apply if Essential: Experience in technical program management or operations roles at the intersection of R&D, product development, and field testing in high-complexity environments (e.g., autonomous systems, robotics, aerospace, advanced mobility). Proven track record of managing programs, demonstrations, or operations that require close coordination between technical development teams and field execution. Experience managing third-party vendors or subcontractors against SLAs, including performance audits and corrective action plans. Deep experience with test planning, operational readiness frameworks, and structured field-to-technical feedback loops. Ability to influence across teams and geographies in fast-moving technology environments. Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with experience leading cross-functional workshops and coordinating across Engineering, Science, Product, and Operations. Proficiency with operational data: defining metrics, creating/interpreting dashboards, and using them to identify bottlenecks. Clear written communication, including SOPs, launch checklists, and executive updates. Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities. Willing to travel up to 30% across launch markets. Desirable: Experience in autonomous vehicles, advanced driver assistance systems, or rideshare/mobility marketplace operations. Background in safety management systems, incident investigation or operator competence frameworks. Experience with AV permitting or deployment in one or more markets. Comfortable with project management tools (e.g., Confluence, Asana/Jira) and implementing operational tracking systems. Knowledge of process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) or operational excellence frameworks. Familiarity with vehicle commissioning, fleet management systems, or automotive safety protocols. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen - 30 mins Competency Interviews - 45 mins Deep-dive technical interviews - Case Study Presentation - 1 hour Final interview: mission & values alignment - 30 mins What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. title: Manager, Global Controls & Obligations Management, EMEA
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact As Manager, Global Controls & Obligations Management, you’ll build and operate the framework that turns complex EMEA regulatory and partner obligations into practical, tested, and well-evidenced controls across Airwallex’s products, services, and regulated entities. You’ll sit within Regulatory Legal & Compliance and work closely with Regulatory Compliance, Regulatory Legal, Risk, Product, Operations, Finance, and external financial partners to strengthen a control environment that’s scalable, proportionate, and ready for regulatory scrutiny. This role is hands-on and execution-focused: you won’t just interpret rules, you’ll help design, implement, and continuously improve the controls, documentation, and reporting that demonstrate we’re meeting our obligations day to day. You’ll work across the broader global organization to identify gaps, clarify ownership, and embed consistent obligations-management practices across EMEA markets. Identify, interpret, and operationalize regulatory and partner obligations across EMEA jurisdictions, products, and regulated entities, translating them into clear governance, controls, and execution requirements. Manage the end-to-end design and implementation of key regulatory and partner controls, partnering with Product, Operations, Engineering, Risk, and Regulatory Compliance to embed controls into real workflows and systems. Build and maintain regulator- and partner-ready documentation, including obligation mappings, control descriptions, RACIs, testing approaches, evidence standards, and remediation tracking. Engage with EMEA regulators, auditors, and financial partners on control-related inquiries, clearly explaining obligations, control architecture, and how specific controls operate in practice. Support EMEA regulatory exams, audits, inspections, RFIs, and related supervisory engagements by coordinating responses, curating consistent evidence packages, maintaining exam-ready documentation, and partnering with Regulatory Compliance and Regulatory Legal. Contribute to the design and operation of EMEA regulatory reporting and obligations governance, ensuring that reporting requirements, ownership, timing, and source systems are clearly defined and appropriately controlled. Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or duplication across EMEA obligations, controls, and evidence, and drive pragmatic remediation or uplift plans that balance regulatory expectations, partner requirements, and business impact. Help establish consistent obligations-management practices that can scale with Airwallex’s EMEA business and align with the broader global regulatory operating model. This role is remote in the EMEA region. What we're looking for We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. title: Senior Payroll Analyst
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the role We are looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Analyst to join our Global Payroll team and play a key role in the delivery and continuous improvement of payroll across our international markets. This is a senior operational role with responsibility for overseeing payroll activity across multiple countries. You will bring strong payroll expertise, sound judgement and a proactive approach to ensure employees are paid accurately, on time and in compliance with local legislation. Working closely with the Payroll Team, internal HR and People teams, Finance, Tax and external payroll providers, you will take ownership of complex payroll activities, provide subject-matter expertise and act as a key escalation point for payroll issues. The role will also provide opportunities to support international payroll projects, process improvements, system implementations and automation , helping Deliveroo build a scalable and efficient global payroll operation. What you'll be doing Take ownership of the end-to-end payroll delivery for assigned international entities. Partner with local HR, People Operations, Finance and Tax teams to ensure payroll inputs are complete, accurate and delivered within agreed timelines. Review, validate and approve payroll inputs and outputs, identifying discrepancies, trends and potential risks before payroll is finalised. Apply a strong understanding of legislation across multiple jurisdictions, statutory requirements and payroll practices , ensuring processes remain compliant and appropriately controlled. Work closely with external payroll providers, holding them accountable for accuracy, timeliness, compliance and service delivery . Act as a senior escalation point for complex employee and stakeholder payroll queries, providing clear guidance and appropriate resolutions. Perform and oversee payroll reconciliations, payment validation and statutory submissions, ensuring appropriate controls are completed and documented. Analyse payroll data and reporting to identify anomalies, control weaknesses, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement. Maintain strong payroll governance and documentation, ensuring processes, controls and procedures are consistently followed. Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate payroll processes , reducing manual intervention and operational risk. Support and lead payroll-related projects, including system implementations, payroll migrations, integrations, process changes and new entity onboarding . Partner with Technology and payroll vendors to troubleshoot system and integration issues and support effective resolution. Contribute to the development of payroll policies, procedures, controls and best practices across international markets. Share knowledge and provide guidance to Payroll Analysts and other team members, helping to build capability and consistency across the wider team. Stay up to date with changes to payroll legislation and communicate relevant impacts to internal stakeholders and payroll providers. Support the Payroll Lead with wider global payroll initiatives and deputise where required. What you'll bring Significant experience working in a payroll analyst or senior payroll position , ideally within a complex, international organisation. Strong hands-on experience of international payroll , with experience of Italy and/or France payroll highly desirable . Good working knowledge of Italian and/or French payroll legislation, statutory requirements and payroll processes is preferable. Experience managing payroll across multiple countries and working with third-party payroll providers . Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations, payments, statutory reporting and compliance. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate payroll data, identify discrepancies and understand the root cause of issues. Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on payroll accuracy and risk management. Experience of identifying and implementing process improvements, automation and operational efficiencies . Experience supporting or leading payroll projects, system implementations or payroll migrations. Strong Excel skills and confidence working with payroll data and reporting. Experience with Workday/Cloudpay or other HR/payroll technology is preferred. Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge, influence and provide a clear point of view. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex payroll matters clearly to both payroll and non-payroll stakeholders. A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the confidence to question the why and the how behind existing processes. Why Deliveroo? Deliveroo's mission is to build the definitive food company by making food more convenient and accessible. As a technology-driven business in one of the world's fastest-growing industries, Deliveroo offers the opportunity to make a real impact while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment. Deliveroo also offers a wide range of competitive benefits across health, family, finance, community, convenience, growth, time away and relocation. There is no judgement when it comes to the things that make people who they are — whether that is gender, race, sexuality, religion or even a secret aversion to coriander. If you are passionate about food and excited to help shape one of the fastest-growing companies in an exciting space, Deliveroo would love to hear from you. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. title: Inside Account Executive | SMB MEA | Existing customers
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="p1">At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.</p> <p>The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.</p> <p> </p></div><p style="text-align: justify;"><strong>What you’ll do at Jamf:</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <div style="text-align: justify;"> <p>The Inside Account Executive is a key member of the EMEIA sales team, helping existing customers and channel partners understand how they can make the management and the security of their Apple devices robust and easy. The role works with the extended sales team to hit individual targets as well as contributing to the overall MEA sales goals.</p> <p> </p> <p style="font-weight: 400;">This role is offered as hybrid, with the expectation to be in the office in London (7–10 Chandos Street, London W1G 9DQ) 3 days per week. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the UK and have sponsorship to live and work in the UK #LI-Hybrid</p> <p> </p> <p><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What you can expect to do this role:</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Communicate regularly with a defined list of existing accounts throughout the year to identify areas of need for business growth and new solutions</li> <li>Own on-time renewal for your entire SMB customer portfolio; consistently meet or exceed retention rate targets.</li> <li>Proactively engage customers 90–120 days ahead of renewal to understand health, flag risks, and secure commitment</li> <li>Understand customer business needs and schedule technical demonstrations or face to face meetings with SE as required.</li> <li>Identify and qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the existing customer base by aligning Jamf solutions to customer business needs and industry insights.</li> <li>Execute campaigns to drive traffic to online and in-person events</li> <li>Enter new Opportunities and related information into SalesForce.com to document and manage sales activities</li> <li>Develop well-rounded understanding of JAMF sales philosophy, market and customers</li> <li>Know how to position JAMF Software solutions against competitor offerings</li> <li>Accurately process customer transactions such as price quotations and purchase orders</li> <li>Grow understanding of and ability to explain business value of JAMF Software solutions to prospects and existing customers</li> <li>Responsible for leading and closing sales opportunities for the Strategic Commercial team</li> <li>Performs all job responsibilities in alignment with the core values, mission and purpose of the organization</li> <li>Adheres to the highest moral, ethical and legal standards to deliver an environment that promotes respect, innovation and creativity</li> <li>Supports and promotes a positive, inclusive workplace one in which the talents and strengths of our increasingly diverse workforce are welcomed, further developed and manifested in our work</li> </ul> <p> </p> </div> <p style="text-align: justify;"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What we are looking for:</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <ul> <li>Professional working proficiency in English is required and Arabic is preferred but not required.</li> <li>Minimum of 2+ years of experience in a sales, business or entrepreneurial role (required).</li> <li>General Experience selling in both direct and indirect (channel) models (Preferred)</li> <li>General Experience navigating and negotiating legal agreements (Required)</li> <li>General Experience in software sales within high-growth technology companies (Preferred)</li> <li>Ability to work independently and coordinate well with other team members that are remote</li> <li>Ability to interact effectively with prospects and customers via phone and email</li> <li>Ability to balance areas of responsibility across multiple territories</li> <li>10% travelling expected</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS</strong><span class="markedContent"><br></span></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.</li> <li>Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.</li> <li>Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Why Jamf?</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="9313">Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="9313">Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="9313">Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="9313">Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="9313">Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="9313">We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="9313">We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="9313">You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="9313">We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="9313">You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What it means to be a Jamf?<br></strong>We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.  </p> <p>Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.  </p> <p>Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement. </p> <p><br><strong>What does Jamf do?</strong><strong><br></strong>Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.</p> <p>Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf</p> <p> </p> <p class="p1"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at <a ---------- <p class="p1"> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
