We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.</p> <p>As a Software Engineering Intern, you will join a team of engineers to build features that contribute directly to the Databricks platform. We're hiring across all of our teams, including full stack, backend, infrastructure, systems, tools, cloud, databases, and customer-facing products. You will have a dedicated mentor and will join our 2027 intern cohort where you'll connect with engineers, other interns, and leaders from across the company.</p> <p>We are hiring Software Engineering Interns across multiple offices. Please apply for the single location that you're the most interested in, and we will discuss more with you as you move through the process. We can only consider one application in 30 days. </p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with a team to build features for the Databricks platform</li> <li>Manage your project end-to-end, including design, code, and feedback</li> <li>Learn about building a platform that scales quickly while maintaining quality and security</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will graduate between Autumn 2027 and Summer 2028 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related subject</li> <li>You have implementation skills with a general purpose program language, such as Python, Java, or C++</li> <li>You have good knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and OOP principles</li> <li>You are excited to solve ambiguous problems with a collaborative team</li> </ul> <p>This is a Summer 12-week internship. title: Engagement Manager, London FTC
description: ABOUT BEAMERY With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies. We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people. So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all. What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: Building agentic AI with advanced orchestration (multi-agent workflows, tool use, evaluation loops) that turns complex talent data into decisions. Training and fine-tuning our own models on unique data about jobs, skills and tasks, and benchmarking them against the best in our market. Joining an award-winning AI team (ACM RecSys Challenge 2026) that turns new ideas into innovative solutions with scientific rigour. Sharing our work and learning from industry peers through challenges, conferences and publications. But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Temporary Engagement Manager to join our Professional Services team for a year in 2027. In this role you will be responsible for end-to-end customer management/projects from kick-off to closure, ensuring successful deliverables such as charter, scope, product requirements, communication, and document gatherings, and create/communicate project performance guidelines for internal/external stakeholders ensuring key deliverables are met. ABOUT THE TEAM Our Professional Services function comprises both the Implementation Services, and Integration Services teams. Their job is to understand the requirements and ROI expectations of our customer projects and guide them on a journey through implementation planning & workflow discovery, platform configuration, user training, tech-stack integration, and user system testing, to ensure they are set up for success. Using a highly-skilled team of Engagement Managers, Solutions Delivery Consultants, and Integrations Consultants, leveraging disciplined project management and industry-best-practice recommendations, we take customers from concept to deployment, for a successful hand-off to the Customer Success team. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING AT BEAMERY Leverage Beamery’s Implementation Methodologies and manage simultaneous customer projects Learn and Demonstrate competency in the Beamery product suite Accelerate the time to value of customer project outcomes by partnering with our customers to deliver the solution charter, scope, and success plan Work with our Customer’s PM’s to develop plans and weekly updates and measure, track & evaluate progress Manage SOW and Contracts to ensure change/control procedures or plan deviations are applied as needed to manage scope, resources, and project budget Lead internal customer outcomes/progress reporting and reviews, issue-tracking lists, and budget/financial tracking and report to customer and internal stakeholders Manage day to day customer relationship during implementation Manage project team resourced and their day to day tasks, review project tasks, schedules, and recommend resource adjustments to respond to changing needs Serve as point of contact for customer project escalation, assess risk, and apply mitigating actions Partner with internal teams such as Product/Engineering, Solutions Delivery, Customer Success to deliver on time, high quality customer deployments Conduct Post Implementation Reviews to enhance methodologies and delivery best practices Up to 30% travel may be required as in-person client meeting requests increase WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? Hands-on Project/Program Management, Implementation, or Business Analyst experience; Enterprise level HR tech/SaaS or similar disruptive software tech industry experience ideal Proven track record delivering complex software product implementations for high-profile customers a huge plus Project Management Methodology and/or Software Development Lifecycle experience Transformation leadership qualities, organizational skills and able to adapt to changing priorities and juggle multiple projects; we’d be excited to see your passion for coaching/developing more junior people – we’re a culture focused on curiosity so our team members should take responsibility for building and coaching our next generation Excellent technical and business communication and presentation skills A growth mindset - the ability to identify where to propose new solutions to achieve long-term business value for the customer and Beamery Experience in Talent/HR technology a huge plus You resonate with our Beamery Values UK Work Authorization required/Beamery is unable to sponsor applicants for work visas Location: London, Hybrid in the office 3 days per week BENEFITS (UK) Competitive pay A wonderful office environment Pension Contribution Unlimited PTO Culture focused on ownership and growth At this time, we are unable to provide Visa sponsorship for this role. Beamery is for Everybody. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to us. We acknowledge the challenges in our industry and strive to develop an inclusive culture where everybody can contribute. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, or caregiver status. If, for whatever reason, you need us to make reasonable adjustments and adaptations to our recruitment process, please email Visit our Diversity, Equality and Inclusion page to learn more about progress and commitments. title: Marketplace Analytics Manager
description: Powering Great Work We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists: 🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business 🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time 🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country As our next Marketplace Analytics Manager you'll sit at the heart of how Checkatrade connects homeowners with tradespeople. You'll decide, with the matching team, which trades appear for which jobs, and you'll keep the marketplace in balance: the right trades in the right places, great matches for homeowners, and real returns for the trades who join us. You'll be data-first, commercially sharp, and trusted by senior leaders to tell them which lever to pull and why. The job, unfiltered Own marketplace health: define what healthy looks like for homeowners and trades, forecast supply and demand by region, category and season, and set clear priorities for the teams that grow our network. Own metric integrity and diagnose what’s driving marketplace performance: define what our numbers mean, find the cause, size the impact, lay out the trade-offs, and track whether the change worked. Decide when to send a lead, to whom and how, so trades see real value and stay engaged. Understand how trades respond to lead delivery, and use simulation to choose which lever to pull and by how much. Own the matching roadmap with Product and Applied Science, prioritised by commercial impact and value to our trades. The fit 5+ years in marketplace, growth or commercial analytics, with a track record of finding the cause and driving the change that moved the outcome. Super strong with data: fluent in SQL, with a solid grounding in experiments. Commercial instinct: you can weigh both sides of a marketplace and size the revenue and retention impact of a decision. Experience forecasting supply and demand and defining marketplace health measures, ideally with price sensitivity or elasticity. Thrives with ownership: you can influence Product, Sales, trade acquisition, CRM and senior leaders, and explain complex findings in a way that moves a decision. Experience in a marketplace, subscription or lead-generation business is a bonus, as are Python, simulation, and tools like Tableau or Looker. (Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. title: Associate Director, Activation, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3986 - Associate Director, Activation, UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>As Digital PR Associate Director, you will lead and nurture our talented digital PR team and take overall ownership of key client accounts.</p> <p>You’ll set the strategic direction for our campaigns, build lasting, trusted relationships with clients, and champion top-quality work that earns standout press coverage and drives meaningful organic growth. We’re looking for someone who loves developing people just as much as landing big campaigns. This includes acting as a supportive coach and mentor for the team, helping us evolve our digital PR products and new business pitches, while keeping us at the forefront of modern search and AI.</p> <p>In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and inspire our digital PR team, line managing a small team and helping everyone build their skills, confidence, and career pathways.</li> <li>Direct all key client accounts, setting overarching strategies, leading meetings, and making sure our work delivers real organic search value and AI discoverability.</li> <li>Act as a trusted senior partner for clients, getting under the skin of their business, handling trickier questions with a calm head, and proactively suggesting creative ideas that push their brands forward.</li> <li>Take overall accountability for the quality of your team’s output, from creative brainstorming and campaign concepts through to press releases, expert commentary, and media lists.</li> <li>Work hand-in-hand with our SEO, Content, and Planning teams to make sure off-site digital PR connects seamlessly into wider brand and organic search plans.</li> <li>Oversee day-to-day team resourcing, delegation, and capacity planning – keeping delivery smooth, managing scopes sensibly, and making sure the team isn’t overservicing or burning out.</li> <li>Coach and support team managers to develop their own leadership styles, guide complex deliverables, and give clear, constructive feedback to junior colleagues.</li> <li>Work closely with the Head of Performance Content to shape our service offering, develop fresh digital PR products, and spot smart ways to bring AI tools into our everyday workflows.</li> <li>Play an active part in agency growth by helping write RFP responses, pitching to prospective clients, and identifying natural up-sell and cross-sell opportunities.</li> <li>Support team leadership with practical day-to-day operations, including recruitment, onboarding, and team structures.</li> <li>Balances bold creative thinking with a sharp commercial eye, making sure every campaign maximises client investment and drives meaningful business impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be <strong>Extraordinary</strong> by <em>Leading Collectively</em> to <em>Inspire transformational Creativity.</em></li> <li>Create an <strong>Open</strong> environment by<em> Balancing People and Client Experiences</em> by <em>Cultivating Trust</em>.</li> <li>Lead <strong>Optimistically</strong> by <em>Championing Growth</em> <em>and Development</em> to <em>Mobilise the Enterprise</em>.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience in digital PR (ideally with solid agency experience), with a proven track record of leading accounts, developing strategies that meet business objectives, and earning high-tier coverage and links.</li> <li>Natural leadership and people skills, with real experience managing, coaching, and developing team members with a patient, supportive mindset.</li> <li>A deep understanding of how digital PR, SEO, content strategy, and AI discoverability work together to drive genuine organic visibility.</li> <li>Strong press release writing skills and sound editorial judgement to understand what story angles will land with relevant media publications.</li> <li>A confident, honest, and thoughtful communicator who can talk through strategies, challenges, and results with senior clients and colleagues in an engaging, jargon-free way.</li> <li>Experience directing multiple accounts, managing team scopes and time reconciliations, and keeping projects running smoothly.</li> <li>A creative problem-solver who stays calm, constructive, and solutions-focused when challenges or tight deadlines crop up.</li> <li>Someone who is comfortable getting involved in new business pitches, writing proposals, and spotting commercial opportunities to grow accounts organically.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of core digital PR and SEO tools (like Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, BuzzStream, and Roxhill), with an open, enthusiastic attitude toward experimenting with AI tools to work smarter.</li> <li>A genuine team player who enjoys collaborating across different agency teams and building positive, lasting relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location.</em><em>Please read our </em><a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy"><em>Privacy Notice</em></a><em> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</em></p> <p><em>#LI-Promoted</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London | 💰 £60k – £80k base salary | £100k – £135k OTE  + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits">Benefits</a></p> <h3><strong>Our Monzo Business team ⭐</strong></h3> <p>Monzo Business helps businesses manage their money, and more than a million businesses (1 in 6!) in the UK bank with us. Now, we’re exploring how we can help more established businesses switch to Monzo, across the UK and Europe 🚀</p> <p>Many of those businesses have more complex needs. They may need help understanding whether Monzo is right for them, moving their banking or getting the most from our products. A great conversation with the right person can make a real difference.</p> <p>We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. Now we’re looking for a Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives and help us turn what we’re learning into a repeatable, effective sales motion.</p> <p>This is a chance to build something new. You’ll coach your team, help them deliver great results and use what you see every day to make the way we sell better. You’ll work closely with Revenue Operations (RevOps), Product and other teams to improve our processes and customer journeys.</p> <p>You’ll also help build an AI-first sales motion from the start. We want someone who’s curious about AI and automation, actively experiments with new tools and can help the team spend more time on conversations that matter.</p> <h3><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a team of Account Executives.</strong> Manage a pod of 6–8 people and be accountable for its performance, from reaching the right businesses and converting opportunities to customer activation and quality. Translate the wider Business strategy and set clear expectations, understand what’s driving results and act when performance needs to improve.</li> <li><strong>Coaching and developing your team.</strong> Spend time listening to calls, reviewing opportunities and giving clear, regular feedback. Help each person build their skills and confidence, recognise great work and address underperformance fairly. Help hire and onboard new team members as we grow.</li> <li><strong>Building the sales motion.</strong> Turn what you and your team learn into better ways of working. Spot friction in lead handling, follow-up, handovers and the sales process; test improvements, measure their impact and share what works so we can build a repeatable playbook.</li> <li><strong>Staying close to customers.</strong> We expect Sales Managers to also take a few sales calls each week and make a few sales a month. Use what you learn from customers and the sales journey to coach the team, identify product needs and improve the motion. Most of your time will be spent leading the team and improving how we work.</li> <li><strong>Helping shape our Products.</strong> Share what you learn from customers with Product to help shape our proposition and priorities, and use what we learn to improve how we sell.</li> <li><strong>Putting AI and automation to work.</strong> Experiment with tools, agents and workflows that help the team research prospects, prepare for conversations, follow up or learn from calls. Work with specialist teams to test ideas responsibly, understand their impact and help the team adopt what works.</li> <li><strong>Making good decisions with data.</strong> Use pipeline, conversion, activation, productivity and quality data to understand where the team is doing well and where customers or opportunities are getting stuck. Keep the pipeline accurate and work with RevOps on reporting and forecasting.</li> <li><strong>Working as one team.</strong> Bring frontline insight to RevOps, Product, Marketing and Operations. Help shape the tools, processes and customer journeys Sales needs, and work together to solve problems that affect your team and customers.</li> <li><strong>Earning customers’ trust.</strong> Build a culture that puts customers first. Coach your team to understand their needs, represent Monzo accurately and deliver good outcomes. Raise concerns early and work with Risk, Compliance and Legal when needed.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ve managed and developed a sales team. You can share examples of how you’ve coached individuals, given feedback and improved performance, including when conversations were difficult.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses in a relatively high-volume environment. You can balance an efficient process with thoughtful, customer-focused conversations.</li> <li>You’re a builder. You’ve spotted a problem in how a team sells, tried a better approach and helped people put it into practice. You’re comfortable making progress when the playbook is still being written.</li> <li>You’ve actively experimented with AI or automation at work and are keen to explore what agents and new workflows can do. You can tell us what you tried, the problem you were solving and what you learned.</li> <li>You’re happy to stay hands-on with customers. You enjoy sales conversations yourself and use what you learn to help others improve.</li> <li>You use data to understand performance. You can look at a funnel or pipeline, ask good questions and turn the answers into practical action.</li> <li>You work well with people in different teams. You can explain what your team and customers need, share evidence and help colleagues find solutions together.</li> <li>You care about doing the right thing for customers. You’re comfortable working within clear standards and learning what it takes to sell in a regulated environment.</li> <li>You might have built your experience in financial services, technology or another business selling to businesses. We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than the exact path you took to get here.</li> <li>You don’t need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you think you could make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t have everything that’s listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h3><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>💰 £60k – £80k base salary, plus on-target commission based on team performance. Total on-target earnings are approximately £100k – £135k</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office. You’ll work from the office at least 3 days a week to stay close to your team.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Read our <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></h4> <ul> <li>30-minute introductory call with a recruiter</li> <li>A full interview loop covering role-specific skills, behaviours and values</li> <li>A conversation with a member of the team</li> <li>Final interview with the hiring manager at our London office</li> </ul> <p>We’ll share more details about the interview process and timing as you progress. Your schedule is important to us, so we’ll be as flexible as possible.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-OH #LI-LONDON</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: Security Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Manager
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We are hiring a <strong>Security Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Manager</strong> to lead the team that keeps Canonical's security and compliance credible to the Enterprises, Clouds, Telcos and Governments that run on Ubuntu, and to bring our controls and risk management to the standard a public company requires.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Location</strong>: EMEA or Americas — fully remote (home-based), with the option to work from our London office.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>About our Team</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Canonical's customers trust Ubuntu with critical systems. That trust rests on evidence: our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications, how we manage risk, and how we respond as security regulation such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act reaches open source software. The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team produces that evidence and makes it real across the company. As Canonical prepares to list on a public exchange, the team is also central to the controls and risk reporting our Audit Committee and Board rely on.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The team is part of Operations and reports to the Chief Operating Officer. It covers both sides of the discipline: keeping us certified and compliant today, and looking ahead at risk across corporate IT, infrastructure and products. It works closely with Engineering, Security Operations, Information Systems, Legal, Finance and Sales.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">You will lead the team, set its priorities and operating rhythm, and be the first escalation point for security and compliance decisions.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>What you'll do</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Lead and develop a team of GRC engineers: hire, coach and set priorities, and run a roadmap that balances planned work with operational requests, so the team delivers predictably and reports progress clearly to leadership. You own the team’s budget, vendors and tooling.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Own our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications end to end: audit readiness, evidence collection, auditor relationships and fieldwork, so certifications are renewed on time with clean outcomes.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Run the risk management framework across corporate IT, infrastructure and products — asset classification, risk assessments, the risk register and key risk indicators — so leadership and the Board can see and decide on the company’s most important risks.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Own the information security policy framework — annual reviews, new policies, exceptions and risk acceptance — and make the call, or escalate it, when a policy and a business need conflict.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Partner with Finance on IT General Controls and internal controls over financial reporting — remediation, control execution and Audit Committee reporting — to make Canonical ready for a public listing.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Turn security regulation and standards — the EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, DORA, the EU AI Act and IEC 62443 — into practical programmes with Legal and Engineering, including our secure software development lifecycle and penetration testing, so our products meet their obligations as they ship.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Build business continuity and disaster recovery with Information Systems and business owners — impact analysis, plans and tested recovery — so critical services can be restored when it matters.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Oversee third-party risk, access reviews and the governance of new tools and AI usage, and support customers and colleagues when it counts — security questionnaires, RFPs, our Trust Center, contract security terms and incident response — alongside Sales, Legal and Security Operations.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Hands-on ownership of ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 certification through external audit cycles</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience designing or running a risk management framework (such as ISO 27005, NIST CSF or ISO 31000), including a risk register and reporting to senior leadership</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience with IT General Controls supporting financial audits, under SOX or an equivalent regime</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience leading a governance, risk and compliance, security compliance or IT risk team in a software or technology company</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience turning regulatory and technical requirements into controls that engineering and business teams you don’t manage actually adopt</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Sound judgement on risk acceptance and policy exceptions, and the confidence to hold a position with senior stakeholders</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience preparing a company for a public listing</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience with product security compliance for a software vendor (EU Cyber Resilience Act, IEC 62443 or NIST SSDF)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Business continuity and disaster recovery programme experience</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>How we work</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">We look for a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results, backed by self-motivation and drive. Our people deliver their work precisely, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliability is at our core, where colleagues deliver high quality work that builds trust and confidence. We make ourselves accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Finally we are adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Distributed work environment, with bi-annual team travel to connect in person</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Priority Pass for travel</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Bi-annual compensation review</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Recognition rewards</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Annual holiday leave</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Maternity and paternity leave</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>About Canonical</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Canonical is an <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/company-culture/identity">equal opportunity employer</a>. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination, and regardless of your identity we will give your application fair consideration.</span></p>

title: General Counsel (Office based)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong> to lead Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function and to build the legal architecture a public company needs — commercial contracting, corporate governance, intellectual property and compliance — in a software business that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and advise the CEO, CFO and the Board directly.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: <strong>Location</strong>: This role can be home-based in EMEA, or office-based in our London, UK office.</p> <h3><strong>About our team</strong></h3> <p>Canonical’s Legal and Compliance function is a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. It owns the terms on which Ubuntu and our commercial products reach the market: open source and intellectual property licensing, enterprise and channel contracting, data protection, export controls and trade, competition, and the governance a company preparing to list has to be able to evidence.</p> <p>Canonical is founder-led, profitable and growing, and privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. That makes this a function in transition. The work is as much building the architecture — a management layer across two regions, standard contracting positions, controls, policies and records — as it is advising on live matters, and it is done in a company that regularly does things the industry has not done before, so the precedents often do not exist.</p> <p>The team works with Product and Engineering on licensing and IP, with Security on customer assurance, with Finance on listing readiness and controls, and with Sales on the commitments we make to customers. As General Counsel you lead that team, set its standards, and advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board and its committees directly.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the global Legal and Compliance function: set its structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas, so the business gets consistent answers wherever it operates.</li> <li>Build the management layer: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Set the operating cadence of the function: how legal work is taken in and prioritised, what internal clients can expect and when, and how workload and risk are reported to the leadership team.</li> <li>Own public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and support Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Own the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Lead intellectual property and open source licensing strategy: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Own the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition, and AI regulation.</li> <li>Manage litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, and own the external counsel panel, its budget and the quality of its work.</li> <li>Advise on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Qualified as a lawyer, with a law degree or equivalent and an active licence to practise in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>In-house legal leadership in a software or technology company — a business that licenses its own products, rather than one that buys technology to run its operations.</li> <li>Commercial technology contracting: enterprise software and subscription agreements, channel and reseller agreements, cloud and services, and hardware manufacturer agreements.</li> <li>Open source licensing: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and how open source communities work in practice.</li> <li>Corporate governance for a listed company, or for one preparing to list: board and committee support, delegated authority, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>Building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English, with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally two to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practising as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How we work</strong></p> <p>We look for a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results, backed by self-motivation and drive. Our people deliver their work precisely, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliability is at our core, where colleagues deliver high quality work that builds trust and confidence. We make ourselves accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Finally we are adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</p> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Staff Brand Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 <strong>London </strong>| 💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</strong> |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <h4><strong>⭐ Our Design team</strong></h4> <p>We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</p> <p>Our brand helps make Monzo recognisable and human, whether someone is opening the app, visiting our website or seeing a campaign for the first time. As we grow, there’s a big opportunity to evolve how our brand shows up and make those experiences feel connected.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Brand Designer</strong> to help shape the future of Monzo’s visual identity, lead and develop designers, and set a high bar for creative work across the company.</p> <p>You’ll join our digital-first internal creative studio and work closely with our Global Creative Director, designers and writers. You’ll also partner with teams across Product Design and Marketing, as well as external agencies, to bring ambitious ideas to life.</p> <p>This is for a designer who loves getting into the detail as much as shaping the bigger picture and helping others grow. You’ll bring strong conceptual thinking, art direction and typography to your work, and support a team of designers to do their best work too.</p> <h4><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Shaping our creative direction.</strong> Work with the Global Creative Director and partners across Monzo to evolve our visual identity and set a clear strategic direction for how the brand shows up globally.</li> <li><strong>Leading ambitious work. </strong>You’ll lead projects from idea to delivery and oversee work led by others, helping the team solve problems and deliver their best work. You’ll spot opportunities, create briefs and bring the right people together to make ideas happen. You’ll thrive working across multiple projects and teams at once.</li> <li><strong>Creating standout design.</strong> You’ll lead by example, setting a high bar for craft, concept and execution across the team. You’ll bring ideas to life across campaigns, marketing, product and other brand touch points, inspiring others through the quality of your work.</li> <li><strong>Managing and developing designers.</strong> Lead and support a small team of designers, helping them grow through regular feedback, coaching and career development conversations. Use Monzo’s levelling frameworks to support their progression and set clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Raising the bar across the team.</strong> Lead critiques, share thoughtful feedback and mentor designers beyond your direct reports. Help create the conditions for people to do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Connecting brand and product.</strong> Partner with Product Design teams to bring Monzo’s brand to life in the app, including developing visual concepts, art direction and motion storyboards for customer experiences.</li> <li><strong>Evolving our brand systems.</strong> Develop guidelines, design principles and reusable assets that help teams create consistent, distinctive work as Monzo grows.</li> <li><strong>Influencing decisions across teams.</strong> Bring people together around a creative vision, explain the thinking behind your work and navigate trade-offs between customer needs, creative ambition and business goals.</li> <li><strong>Working with creative partners.</strong> Collaborate with external agencies and specialists, providing clear direction and feedback to make sure their work feels right for Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Improving how we work.</strong> Spot opportunities to make our creative process more effective, whether that’s through new tools, better ways of working or clearer guidance for teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have a strong portfolio of brand design and campaign work, showing how you’ve developed distinctive creative ideas and brought them to life across different channels.</li> <li>You’re an expert in your craft, with particular strength in <strong>typography, visual identity and art direction</strong>. You care about the details and can show how they make the overall work stronger.</li> <li>You have <strong>experience managing and developing designers</strong>, including giving feedback, supporting career growth and helping people do their best work.</li> <li>You’ve led complex creative projects from brief to delivery, making decisions, bringing people with you and maintaining a high standard throughout.</li> <li>You can think beyond a single project: you’ve helped shape a brand’s direction, developed design systems or guidelines, or improved how creative work happens across a team or organisation.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working with ambiguity. You can define a direction, navigate competing priorities and make thoughtful trade-offs without losing sight of the bigger picture.</li> <li>You’re proactive, creating your own briefs, bringing the right people together to accomplish your goals. You’re not just a doer, but a problem solver and a self-starter.</li> <li>You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, working across multiple teams and projects at the same time. </li> <li>You’re a confident collaborator who can explain and advocate for your ideas with designers, cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>You enjoy raising the quality of design beyond your own work, through mentoring, critique and sharing what you know.</li> <li>You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using the tools you need to develop and deliver your ideas. You have a clear interest in AI tools and are keen to explore and use them to evolve how we work and what we create across design, marketing and product.</li> <li>You have experience working in a digital-first brand, creative agency or in-house team, and can show how your work has supported customer or business goals.</li> <li>You can develop ideas for motion and communicate them through storyboards or creative direction. You don’t need to be a motion specialist.</li> </ul> <p>We’d also love to see experience across areas such as web design, campaigns, print, film, illustration or 3D. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them.</p> <h4><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h4> <p>💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</strong></p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home. All employees are given a MacBook.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Take a look at our<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>30-minute call with our Recruiter</strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Brand Design team. </strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour interview covering values & ways of working. </strong></li> </ul> <p>To be considered for this role you will need to include your CV and a portfolio showcasing your work. This will allow us to better understand your experience. We’d particularly love to see projects you’ve led from start to finish, including the thinking behind the work, the impact it had and your individual contribution.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using AI to support your application and interviews at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-TR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: Forward Deployed Architect
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes. This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value. You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams. The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption. - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale. - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation. - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value. - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback. - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path. - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements. - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role. - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria. - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions. - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows. - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively. - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value. - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness. - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences. - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward. - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers. - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows. - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up. - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements. - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges! We are looking to introduce a Senior Financial Control Analyst on a 9 Month Fixed Term Contract. </p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial HM Interview </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TP1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: Account Executive, Growth (EMEA)
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. As an Account Executive at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product and help high-impact companies build better software. Location & work mode While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role is specifically based in London. We’re looking for someone who can work from our London office in Shoreditch 3 days per week (Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays), as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region. What you'll do - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly and annual targets - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team What we're looking for - 5+ years in a quota-carrying sales role - Experience selling to a technical audience; bonus if you have previous experience working with a collaboration or developer tool - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators What we offer We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect: - Competitive salary and equity - Employee-friendly equity terms - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday - Health coverage (based on country requirements) - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays - 4 months paid parental leave - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter - Regular team events and off-sites Learn how we think and work - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM - Make an Org Chart You Want to Ship — Advice from Linear on How Heirloom Tomatoes Should Inspire Team Design https://review.firstround.com/make-an-org-chart-you-want-to-ship-advice-from-linear-on-how-heirloom-tomatoes-should-inspire-team-design/ - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). Experience working in regulatory stress testing exercises (such as ICAAP or EBA Stress-testing) is highly desirable but not essential. </p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"><strong> </strong>BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and predictive modelling and data visualisation (via streamlit)</li> <li>Anaplan for model implementation</li> <li>Github for version control</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assisting with continuous improvement of forecasting models via individual delivery or through others</li> <li>Development of best practices for financial modelling across Monzo</li> <li>Presenting forecast model results to senior management</li> <li>Close collaboration with portfolio strategy, model validation, finance and external audit teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a background in financial forecast modelling or execution</li> <li>You have strong analytical skills and a track record of using these to deliver technical projects</li> <li>You have a solid technical toolkit. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered.
